description: This file defines the DevelopmentClusterMembershipOptionsValidator class, which implements configuration validation logic for development cluster membership options in Orleans. It checks if the membership table is of a specific type and whether the primary silo endpoint is set.

classes.description: A class that validates development cluster membership options in Orleans.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with options and service provider.
